name: Core Architecture & Language Models
description: The official RWKV-4/5/6/7 papers, architectural variants, hybrids with attention, distillation into RWKV, and large-scale language model training.

name: Surveys & Analysis
description: Surveys of the RWKV ecosystem and empirical analyses of what RWKV models learn.

name: State, Memory & Long Context
description: Exploiting the recurrent WKV state: state tuning, reusable states for retrieval, state stability over extreme context, and long-sequence generation.

name: Hardware & Efficiency
description: Quantization, compression and dedicated hardware accelerators (FPGA, on-chip, neuromorphic) for RWKV inference.

name: NLP & Language Applications
description: RWKV language models applied to translation, code, moderation, compression, domain LLMs, knowledge graphs and decoding.

name: Multimodal & Vision-Language
description: Vision-language models, CLIP-style representation learning, visual grounding, tracking and other cross-modal RWKV systems.

name: Computer Vision
description: Vision-RWKV backbones, segmentation, detection, image generation/diffusion, style transfer and pose estimation.

name: Image Restoration, Enhancement & Fusion
description: Low-level vision with RWKV: denoising, deraining, dehazing, low-light enhancement, super-resolution, image compression and image fusion.

name: Medical & Biomedical
description: Medical image segmentation, restoration, translation and registration, plus biomedical signal analysis (EEG, fMRI, sleep staging).

name: Remote Sensing & Earth Observation
description: Pan-sharpening, hyperspectral imaging, change detection, semantic segmentation, sonar and weather radar with RWKV.

name: 3D & Point Clouds
description: RWKV for point cloud learning, completion, semantic occupancy prediction and LiDAR place recognition.

name: Video & Action
description: Action recognition and detection, video editing, forgery localization and video captioning.

name: Speech, Audio & Music
description: Speech recognition, enhancement, TTS, voice activity detection, audio tagging, speech compression and symbolic music.

name: Time Series & Forecasting
description: RWKV for forecasting (energy, weather, traffic), anomaly detection and time-series foundation models.

name: Reinforcement Learning & Robotics
description: Decision-making, manipulation, odometry, robot control and autonomous-driving planning built on RWKV.

name: Science, Engineering & Other Domains
description: Molecules and RNA, physics surrogates, wireless communication, network security, recommendation and industrial monitoring.

name: Spiking & Quantum RWKV
description: Neuromorphic spiking RWKV language models and quantum-enhanced RWKV variants.
